rules: Price-range numerators ($open-$low, $high-$low) over a dollar_volume-based denominator (TS_RANK, LOG, or TS_STD of $dollar_volume) failed cheap_screen 3x (0.06-0.81) this round. A volume-delta numerator over a dollar_volume TS_MAX denominator was accepted instead (4.563), so match dollar_volume denominators to volume-family numerators, not price-range ones.

Three archive_subtree rejects this round all came from reusing a claimed denominator chassis: TS_SUM($dollar_volume,21), TS_STD($volume,21), or TS_MAX($high,21), each +1e-8, even behind a new numerator or an extra fundamental CS_RANK leg multiplied in front. Treat these chassis as fully closed, not just their exact parent expression.

RANK($earnings_per_share) - RANK(X) still fails for X's in the volume/dollar_volume/close-level family: TS_DELTA($volume,3)/$volume hit rho 0.927 despite normalizing, TS_RANK($dollar_volume) at 63 vs 126 hit 0.972, and bare TS_RANK($close,21) lost too much IC on simplify. The one accept (6.901) used a close-normalized high-low ratio as X, so look outside the volume/dollar_volume/close-level family.

MIN($earnings_per_share,0) isolates the minority negative-eps case and decorrelated (accepted 4.297). MAX($earnings_per_share,0) is a rank no-op since eps is mostly positive, landing at rho 0.999 vs unclipped eps/close. Clip toward the rarer sign, not the common one.

Price-range times absolute volume delta passed as two separately-ranked terms multiplied, CS_RANK(...) * TS_RANK(...), at 4.136, but failed as a raw product wrapped in a single TS_RANK (0.87 cheap_screen). Rank each leg before combining rather than ranking after multiplying raw legs.

Volume-surprise gating ($volume > TS_MEAN($volume,w)) is still productive for COUNT and IF_ELSE-gated $return, both accepted this round. Gating a signed volume sum on return-sign instead (IF_ELSE($return>0,$volume,-$volume)) failed cheap_screen, so gate volume by volume, not by return sign.

COUNT($volume > TS_MEAN($volume,10),21) passed (1.729) but the same shape on $dollar_volume with a 126-day window failed cheap_screen (0.37), confounding field and window in one change. Retest a short-window dollar_volume count before ruling the field out.

ABS($close-$open) or ($close-$open) over a dollar-volume-sum denominator matches Alpha#101's formula bank regardless of the outer wrapper. Avoid rebuilding intraday body-size ratios from raw close/open.
